description: Shows your Orca workspace, branch and agent state on your Discord profile. Every field is opt-in. Not affiliated with Discord.

commands.title: Rich Presence: Show or Hide Panel

settings.title: Show Rich Presence
settings.description: Master switch. Off clears your Discord activity.

settings.title: Detail level
settings.description: How much Orca detail Discord may see. Generic shows no repo, branch or machine name.

settings.title: Discord Application ID
settings.description: Your own Discord Application ID. Leave as is to use the shipped one; an invalid value falls back to it.

settings.title: Machine name
settings.description: Name shown instead of this computer's hostname. Only used when "Show machine name" is on and detail is not Generic. Empty uses the hostname.

settings.title: Show git branch
settings.description: Include the branch name. Needs detail level Full.

settings.title: Show agent state
settings.description: Show whether an agent is working, waiting or blocked.

settings.title: Show terminal count
settings.description: Include how many terminals are open.

settings.title: Show machine name
settings.description: Include the machine name. Needs detail level Full.

settings.title: Show elapsed timer
settings.description: Show an elapsed timer on Discord.

settings.title: Elapsed timer counts
settings.description: Session counts while you work in Orca and resets after 30 minutes with no activity.
enumLabels: Time in the current agent state

settings.title: Show status bar item
settings.description: Show presence state in Orca's status bar.

settings.title: Use HTTP bridge
settings.description: Send presence to the companion app when Discord is not reachable locally, for example from a remote machine.

settings.title: Bridge URL
settings.description: Base URL of the Orca Presence companion that talks to Discord (http or https). Empty when unused.

settings.title: Debug logging
settings.description: Write detailed diagnostics to the plugin log.

settings.title: Button URL
settings.description: HTTPS link for the optional Discord button. Empty means no button.

settings.title: Show button
settings.description: Attach the button to your activity. Needs a Button URL.

settings.title: Button label
settings.description: Text on the Discord button (1-32 characters).

settings.title: Show agent count
settings.description: Include how many agents are running.

settings.title: Hidden panels
settings.description: Panel sections to hide, comma separated: preview, strip, tiles, sink, client, detail, agents, toggles, actions, logs. The eye buttons in the panel edit this.
